definition.failure_rule: fail if a contiguous run above the clipping threshold exceeds 5 ms

application_order: same registered waveform gate on retained file

supplemental_probable_nontermination_or_.reason: A short-input output that reaches the hard generation ceiling did not demonstrate normal termination; the retained audio may be nonterminated or truncated.
supplemental_probable_nontermination_or_.relationship_to_registered_gate: Separate supplemental disqualifier; it does not modify or retroactively reinterpret the registered waveform gate.

battery.repeat_policy: one draw per non-ZH text; three draws per ZH text

generation.seed_derivation: big-endian uint32 from first four bytes of SHA-256('lane-g-moss-v1:g3:{case_id}:{repeat}')
generation.external_text_preprocessing: none; exact frozen input passed to SentencePiece

warning.reason: Lane G requires plausible duration on every short input, but no text-relative duration rule was predeclared. Passing the broad registered [0.15, 30] s waveform-duration gate and avoiding the frame cap therefore cannot be promoted to a plausible-duration PASS.

warnings.reason: Lane G requires plausible duration on every short input, but no text-relative duration rule was predeclared. Passing the broad registered [0.15, 30] s waveform-duration gate and avoiding the frame cap therefore cannot be promoted to a plausible-duration PASS.

runner_execution.note: G3 executed before the untracked runner's exact source hash was retained. The synthesis receipt pins model revisions, weights, prompts, seeds, sampling, text preprocessing, generated-token hashes, and output hashes, but the exact execution-time Python file hash is unavailable.

runner_current_reproduction_version.note: Current committed-candidate runner; not misattributed as the G3 execution-time file.

limits: A generation-cap hit identifies probable nontermination or truncation but does not distinguish between them.
Non-ZH inputs have one sampled draw each; ZH inputs have three. These are not stochastic failure-rate estimates.
Raw stereo tensors were measured before downmix but not retained, so raw metrics cannot be independently recomputed from mono files.
The exact execution-time runner source hash was not retained for G3; the synthesis receipt still pins the effective model, prompt, seed, sampling, token, and waveform evidence.

No text-relative duration threshold was predeclared. Because Lane G nevertheless requires plausible duration on every output, all 19 non-cap draws remain unresolved rather than being promoted to PASS.
The English prompt served EN/ES/FR/RU and the Mandarin prompt served ZH; speaker and prompt diversity were not tested.
This short-input safety probe does not establish intelligibility, correct language, naturalness, licensing, or product acceptance.
